newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil premiums stable to easier, volume low.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil premiums stable to easier, volume low.

text.p: NWE gas oil premiums were stable to slightly easier on Tuesday in low volumes depressed by buyer resistance and a dearth of vessels, traders said.
Benchmark Feb IPE gas oil futures closed down $5.25 at $213.75 a tonne on aggressive long liquidation triggered by a technical sell-off in New York crude and products.
"Most barge players are unravelling all the stuck barges on the large volume done last week. Buyers are deserting a falling market, hoping for easier prices," a trader said.
Refinery grade heating oil barges were unchanged at around Feb +$8 fob Rotterdam and +$5/6.5 fob Amsterdam.
With ice blockages thawing, Rotterdam remained extremely tight but Amsterdam sellers were out in force, traders said.
Low sulphur diesel barges were notionally Feb +$12/13.
Cargoes were quieter. Many players are covered for January and those still trying to supply cannot obtain vessels.
"Demand is as strong as it's going to get," one trader said.

Russian bucked the trend, talked $1 up at $6 under mean quotes fob NWE following at trade at $7 under on Monday. German winter grade heating oil was Feb IPE +$8/9 cif Hamburg. Low sulphur diesel looked well-supported at Feb IPE +$14/16.
